name: Leucine-catabolic organic acidemias and biotin cofactor defects
rationale: Members are inborn errors of leucine/branched-chain acyl-CoA catabolism and of biotin supply to carboxylases (BTD, HLCS, biotin transport), the biotin arm being what the confusables lack.

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion, KATP channels and insulin processing
rationale: All members concern regulation of pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion and the insulin life cycle (incretins, FFAR1, neurotransmitters), with KATP/K2P channels and insulin processing/catabolism distinguishing it from glucagon-receptor and insulin-signaling confusables.

name: Nucleotide sugar and sulfate transporter defects
rationale: Members are Golgi/ER SLC35-family nucleotide-sugar (plus SLC33A1 acetyl-CoA and SLC26A2 sulfate) transport and their genetic defects, unlike confusables centred on sugar biosynthesis, PAPS or GPI anchors.

name: Rho GTPase actin remodeling in filopodia and cytokinetic ring
rationale: Members share Rho-driven actin/septin cytoskeleton organization, and the contractile ring, cleavage furrow, septin ring and citron kinase members set it apart from dendritic and actin-network confusables.

core: Regulation of NF-kappaB transcription factor activity
name: Regulation of NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity
rationale: All members are positive or negative regulation of NF-kappaB signaling or DNA-binding transcription factor activity, without the TLR/cytokine, deubiquitinase or TNFR1 content of the confusables.

qualifier: exocrine/endocrine glands, pharyngeal organs and ear
name: Gland, pharyngeal organ and ear morphogenesis
rationale: Members are development of epithelial glands (lacrimal, salivary, mammary, thyroid, parathyroid), pharyngeal organs (thymus) and ear structures, lacking the limb and craniofacial skeletal members of the confusables.

name: Ear morphogenesis and vestibular-auditory mechanosensation
rationale: All members concern ear development and its sensory function, with gravity sensing, equilibrioception, otoliths and hair-cell mechanotransduction distinguishing it from cranial-nerve and eye development confusables.

name: Two-pore and calcium-activated potassium channels setting membrane potential
rationale: Members are K2P (TWIK, TASK, TREK, TRESK, THIK) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels and the resting potential/hyperpolarization they control, unlike the TALK/TRP, KATP and Na+ transport confusables.

name: Mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion and nuclear envelope remodeling
rationale: Members span chromosome condensation, cohesin loading, CENP-A deposition and mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly/ESCRT-III resealing, the envelope arm being what the cohesion and spindle confusables lack.

name: Drug and steroid xenobiotic biotransformation
rationale: Members are phase I/II metabolism of drugs, steroids and flavonoids (specific drug ADME, sulfonation, cytochromes), distinct from mycotoxin detoxification and SLCO/UGT transport confusables.

qualifier: replication, repair and nuclear envelope targets
name: SUMOylation of replication, repair and nuclear envelope proteins
rationale: All members are SUMO conjugation of specific nuclear substrate classes (including RanBP2-linked Ran mitosis), not the SUMO processing, E1/E2 or transcription-factor targets of confusables.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigens to NKT cells
name: MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members are antigen presentation via MHC class II and CD1/MHC-Ib lipid antigens with NKT cell regulation, lacking the MHC class I cross-presentation and proteasome members of confusables.

qualifier: epigenetic silencing, imprinting and X inactivation
name: DNA and histone methylation in imprinting and silencing
rationale: Members are DNA/histone methyltransferase and demethylase activities driving heterochromatin, imprinting and X inactivation, unlike confusables centred on CHD/NuRD remodeling or non-histone methylation.

name: Regulation of ceramide levels and sphingomyelin breakdown
rationale: All members regulate sphingolipid/ceramide levels, with TNFR1-induced sphingomyelin hydrolysis distinguishing it from glycosphingolipid, de novo synthesis and lipid transfer confusables.

name: Phospholipid and glycolipid transfer and flipping
rationale: Members are non-vesicular phospholipid/glycolipid transfer and P4-ATPase aminophospholipid flipping, distinct from ER tubule, RAB prenylation and phospholipid catabolism confusables.

name: BMP-SMAD signaling in vasculogenesis and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members combine BMP/SMAD signaling regulation with blood vessel formation and endothelial/vascular smooth muscle differentiation, unlike the myocardial, conduction and lymphatic confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-mediated degradation of p53 and Cdc25A
rationale: All three members are ubiquitin-dependent turnover of p53 (via MDM2/COP1) or Cdc25A, whereas confusables are checkpoint kinase and G1/S signaling.

name: NK receptor control of lymphocyte cytotoxicity and tolerance
rationale: Members concern NK receptor (KIR) modules and negative regulation of NK/T cytotoxic activation and peripheral tolerance, lacking the degranulation, MHC-Ib and T-cell costimulation members of confusables.

name: Vitamin E, vitamin K and ubiquinone metabolism
rationale: All members concern metabolism or transport of tocopherol, vitamin K/menaquinone and ubiquinol, unlike confusables centred on gamma-carboxylation or sterol/isoprenoid synthesis.

name: tRNA aminoacylation, wobble modification and mitochondrial translation
rationale: Members are tRNA charging and wobble-position modification feeding mitochondrial translation initiation to termination, unlike the tRNA processing and mitochondrial transcription confusables.

qualifier: neural plate border and dorsoventral axis
name: Neural plate border and dorsoventral axis specification
rationale: Members are anterior/posterior neural plate formation, neural plate border and neural crest fate, and D/V axis determination, lacking the axial mesoderm and hindbrain members of confusables.

name: Rho GTPase actin remodeling in lamellipodial cell motility
rationale: Members are Rho-family GTPase cycles and their actin effectors driving lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis, unlike the focal adhesion, filopodium/cytokinesis and ROCK/PAK confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II promoter escape, pausing and elongation
rationale: All members concern the transition of Pol II from promoter clearance through pausing into regulated elongation, unlike confusables covering Pol I/III, HIV transcription and RNA processing.

name: FGFR3 signaling and FGFR-driven PI3K activation
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding and downstream cascades plus PI3K cascades from FGFR1-4, distinct from confusables centred on FGFR1/2/4 FRS/SHC/PLC signaling and Klotho.

name: Activin and FSH signaling in testis development
rationale: Members combine activin/follistatin signaling, glycoprotein hormone (FSH/LH) secretion and response, and Sertoli/seminiferous tubule development, unlike ovarian and LH-response confusables.
